name: plain-xstate
title: Launch blurb writer (plain XState)

origin.source: New example for driving a library-unaware XState v6 machine

comparison.purpose: Writes and revises a product launch blurb with an ordinary XState machine that knows nothing about the agent library. The runtime binds its draft step to a model, you approve or revise, and the machine's own guard stops REVISE after two rounds.

starters: a CLI that turns shell history into a changelog
a note app that deletes anything you have not opened in a year
